sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Turning and parking

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A02
The no-parking distances climb from fifteen feet at a fire hydrant, to twenty feet from a crosswalk at an intersection, to thirty feet from a stop sign or signal, to fifty feet from the nearest railroad rail [A02].
Why it matters: group parking-distances; difficulty high; prereq sec10-F13; confusables sec10-F13, sec10-F14 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A03
Within twenty feet of a daily-delivery mailbox, on any bridge or tunnel and on any controlled-access highway are all banned parking spots, and a yellow-painted curb marks a no-parking zone [A03].
Why it matters: group parking-distances; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F15; confusables sec10-F15, sec10-F16 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A03
Facing downhill the wheels turn toward the curb, facing uphill with a curb they turn away from the curb, and facing uphill without a curb they turn to the right [A03].
Why it matters: group hill-parking; difficulty high; prereq sec10-F19; confusables sec10-F19 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A04
Parallel parking begins about two feet out from the front vehicle, ends ideally about six inches from the curb, and may never finish more than eighteen inches from it [A04].
Why it matters: group parallel-parking; difficulty high; prereq sec10-F22; confusables sec10-F22, sec10-F23, sec10-F24 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A04
The following-distance count is three to four seconds in normal conditions, at least four seconds in darkness or rain, and at least six seconds on ice or snow [A04].
Why it matters: group following-distance; difficulty high; prereq sec10-F27; confusables sec10-F27, sec10-F28 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A02
Turning around is illegal near a curve or hill crest whenever a vehicle approaching within five hundred feet in either direction cannot see you, and anywhere a sign prohibits it [A02].
Why it matters: group changing-direction; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F08; confusables sec10-F08 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A01
A driver waiting to turn left keeps the wheels straight to avoid being pushed into oncoming traffic, and stops to let opposing traffic through when both would reach the intersection at about the same time [A01].
Why it matters: group left-turns; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F05; confusables sec10-F05, sec10-F06 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A03
An angle-parking entry starts at least five feet out from the parked vehicles, while the exit must never back across the center line [A03].
Why it matters: group angle-parking; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F17; confusables sec10-F17, sec10-F18 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A02
Backing into a parallel space is the only backing the handbook calls acceptable within a traffic lane, and backing across other lanes or through an intersection is never allowed [A02].
Why it matters: group backing; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F10; confusables sec10-F09, sec10-F10 [A02]
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A03
On a grade a manual transmission is left in reverse when facing downhill but in first gear when facing uphill, while an automatic transmission simply goes into park [A03].
Why it matters: group hill-parking; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F20; confusables sec10-F19, sec10-F20 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0056]

corpus_stability.reason: The West Virginia Driver's Licensing Handbook is a periodically revised official edition, so its turning, backing and parking pages change at most with a new edition.
